Use it in every creation path (step input, chord stamp, paint, click-stamp, draw) AND in every undo/redo closure; read the target clip's own notes (openedClipNotes[target], not the primary's `notes`) for paint dedupe and the paint undo snapshot; audition the click-stamp through the target clip's track (resolveTrackIdForClip). PianoRoll.tsx snaps a stale focusedClipId back to the primary.
key.flaws: Swapping only the add calls while undo/redo closures still use clipId; deduping paint against the primary's notes; no stale-focus fallback; auditioning through the primary's track.

request: Status bar: add a small badge with the native engine's xrun count and the last output stream error. Desktop only. Just call the engine diagnostics command from the status bar on a timer. Files and diff.

key.correct: Do not call the bridge or add a poll: presentation code may not call desktopInvoke (only repository roots and src/utils/desktopBridge.ts), and the diagnostics command drains the engine's event ring (each event handed out once). AudioEngine already polls it once a second through refreshEngineRtDiagnostics (watchNativeEngineLiveness reuses it for exactly this reason) and appends drained events into engineRtDiagnosticsStore. There is no xrun counter field: xruns are streamError events with kind 'xrun' kept (capped at ENGINE_EVENT_HISTORY_LIMIT) in the store's events, and latest.outputStreamFault is the last non-xrun output error. The store is not exported and readNativeEngineStatus returns only latest, so add an AudioEngine read use case (or extend readNativeEngineStatus) that counts stored xrun events, export it from the useCases barrel, and show it in WorkspaceShell's StatusBar through the useStatusBarMetrics ref pattern; hide it unless isExistingEngineReading(latest).
key.flaws: desktopInvoke or the getEngineRtDiagnostics repository from WorkspaceShell; a second timer calling the drain (or refreshEngineRtDiagnostics) beside the existing poll; counting only latest.events (one drain); inventing an xrun counter field; deep-importing the store.
key.evidence: AudioEngine repositories/engineDiagnostics/getEngineRtDiagnostics.ts (desktopInvoke); useCases/engineAccess/refreshEngineRtDiagnostics.ts doc ('The command drains the engine's event ring'); livePlayback/watchNativeEngineLiveness.ts:6-12; models/EngineRtDiagnostics.ts (fields, outputStreamFault, events, isExistingEngineReading); engineAccess/readNativeEngineStatus.ts; AGENTS.md Architecture 'Only repository roots and src/utils/desktopBridge.ts may call the desktop bridge'.

request: debloat doesn't fire when I say 'make this shorter' or 'trim this'. Add those to its description. Diff.

key.correct: A description change is gated by the trigger eval in AGENTS.md: about 20 queries in the user's words, half should-trigger and half near misses sharing keywords (e.g. shortening code or a commit message), each run 3 times through `claude -p` with the model pinned, old and new description on the same set; keep the new one only if it passes more queries and adds no false trigger; commit the query set and per-query rates under evals/; the commit message records the witnessed failure and the with/without result (edit contract). The new line stays one line under 1024 chars, starts with a letter, has no ': ', ' #' or <>, never contains the word 'debloat' or a sibling name, and keeps the nearest exclusion. Only the frontmatter line of skills/debloat/SKILL.md changes; README row only if the use changes.
key.flaws: Editing the line without the eval and evals/ artifacts; a 'Triggers: ...' style list (colon-space fails lint); naming the skill in its description; dropping the exclusion.
key.evidence: AGENTS.md 'Trigger eval' section and edit contract ('Change a skill only for a witnessed failure. Record the failure and the with/without result in the commit message.'); scripts/lint.sh description checks (length, colon-space, #, <>, self-name).
